name: cm-agent
description: Agent skills that detect a project's CMS, write a validated publishing spec for it, and publish content through it

plugins.name: cm-agent
plugins.description: Detects the CMS a project publishes to, writes a machine-readable cms-publish.json spec describing its content types, fields, auth, and transport, then publishes content through that spec. Works with file-based systems (Astro, Hugo, Eleventy, Jekyll), headless APIs (Sanity, Contentful, Payload, Strapi, Directus), and hosted CMSes (WordPress, Ghost). Also humanizes AI-sounding drafts before they go out.
